items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: You know George Duke, great guy, great player, you know just kind of knows the whole thing. He let me do some arranging for him.

ctx.x: And I wouldn’t have thought of that, right.

Yeah no, no way. So you know each producer that I’ve worked with has a little bit different approach as to how they get to finished product. You know George Duke, great guy, great player, you know just kind of knows the whole thing. He let me do some arranging for him.
Do horn players still hate synthesizers?
